aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: Both primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The prep_to_transport dependency is the primary signal because Sessions and HTTPAdapter rely on prepared request, hook, cookie, auth, response, and utility contracts.
The proxy_tls_url dependency captures Requests-specific async risk around URL/proxy/TLS helper behavior consumed by adapters.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts and implicated files, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: PreparedRequest, Response, hooks, cookies, auth, and body/header utilities must be stable for Session and HTTPAdapter consumers.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when hook/auth preparation probes and adapter consumer probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The transport agent may implement send or adapter behavior against stale PreparedRequest, hook, cookie, or body-length assumptions.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Proxy selection, URL normalization, auth extraction, and TLS path helpers must match adapter and session expectations.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when URL/proxy utility probes and adapter URL consumer probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The transport agent may encode proxies or request URLs around outdated utility contracts, with failures surfacing only in adapter tests.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Foundation structures, status codes, utilities, and compatibility exports must support package import and vendored dependency checks.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when foundation utility probes and package compatibility probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The integration agent may preserve package exports around stale foundation assumptions, causing import/package tests to fail late.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact visible in the integrated history.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves Requests' preparation-to-transport contracts promptly.
